inspector: Arena agent — direct image inspection of rendered frames
method: COMPS=1 renders one frame at each composition midpoint with transitions suppressed; every frame viewed as a contact sheet at 270x480 and defects traced by probing single scenes at 13 times across their duration.
human_note: The user must watch the finished film. This file records what the agent saw and fixed; it is not a human sign-off and cinema_gate.py will not accept it as one.

compositions.why: open on the bell that never sounded
the silence belongs to this tower
the tower looms as the obstacle
Vellara: a whole valley that waited
every founder in the valley tried
they were skilled, not careless
they poured bronze — shown literally
they tuned the crown
they hung it higher
every time, the whole town waited
hope turning into disappointment
the clapper never moved: the tower stayed silent
a hammer no bigger than her hand
she climbs
the stairwell is long and she is small
resolve on her face
her hand passes the bell without touching it
she is facing the wall, not the bell
she raises the hammer
once — the first tap on stone
twice — she compares the two answers
listening: her ear to the stone
the whole town held its breath
three faces, nobody moving
the bell was never broken: no crack, clean cast
all the way round it, still flawless
The tower was. — the twist lands on her face
the hairline seam in the stone
go inside the stone to see the mechanism
every note dies in the voids
sixty years of swallowed notes belong to this wall
she moves the bell
the rope takes the weight
four feet to the left, and it seats
the clapper strikes — the first sound in sixty years
the sound leaves the tower
they heard it in three villages
the town that mocked her, cheering
the girl they ignored became the one they listened to

defects.what: Bell built upside down (wide base at top) since Round 13; also the cause of flat-yellow macro shots aiming at the narrow apex
defects.fix: removed the PI rotation and re-seated bands, cast seam and VELLARA plate on the corrected profile

defects.what: Ten macro compositions sat inside their own subjects, rendering as flat colour fill
defects.fix: distances raised to 1.0-1.6m with explicit focus heights

defects.what: Seven tower wides were far too close for a 19m tower
Bronze pour glows blown out to white
Faces sat low in every close-up: puppet head centre is ~62% of billboard height, not the 1.6m assumed
defects.fix: added faceY(h) and applied it to all nine close-ups

defects.what: Belfry had no sky, no valley below and no roof; stairwell was an open shaft — frames contained black voids
defects.fix: sky dome, valley floor 14m below, distant mountains, roof, enclosing stair shaft
replaced static bird shot with a lateral track across all three as their windows light in sequence

defects.what: Resolve beat used a grin where the narration is stern determination
Both stone cutaway cameras aimed at x=3.1, inside the seam wall at x=2.7, rendering flat tan for their whole duration
defects.fix: retargeted to the wall plane at x=2.36; found by probing scene 9 at 13 times

defects.what: Framing standard itself was broken: no move builder accepted or forwarded 'focus', so every explicit subject size was discarded and the checker measured generic defaults
defects.fix: all ten builders accept and forward focus; framing() also reports fov and endpoint coverage sweep

defects.what: Forge had no roof, right wall or sky, so the crane ('they hung it higher') rose into black void
defects.fix: sky, right wall with a doorway onto a yard, roof rafters with a smoke vent over the fire

defects.what: Both tapping inserts used positive azimuth, placing the camera behind the seam wall, filming its back face as flat grey
defects.fix: moved to the room side and stood back so Nora, hammer and stone share the frame

defects.what: The stone cutaway was a CLOSED solid box: the air voids and dying sound rings — the central explanation of the story — were sealed inside and invisible
defects.fix: rebuilt as an open section (five slabs, camera-facing side removed) with a sawn rim, darker interior and darker voids

defects.what: Front wall added at z=3.4 sat in the path of both pull-backs, which filmed its outer face as flat cream
Hammer prop sat at head height 0.2m from Nora's face during the listening beat, reading as a hammer stuck in her forehead
defects.fix: drops into her lowered hand, which is also the correct acting beat

defects.what: Final payoff close-up cropped her chin
